story.clean_Japanese:
FIのあねさんよ！
今日こそは決着をつけさせてもらうぜ！
story.english: Well, FI! Today we settle this for good!
story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
story.rationale: The taunt and declaration open the confrontation. Keep the original given-name token.

story.clean_Japanese:
クルシマ！
愚かな所行はやめよ！
story.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
story.rationale: The blunt rebuke sounds right as Yukihisa interrupts his challenge.

story.clean_Japanese:
てめえ、侍のくせに
異国人の肩ぁ持ちやがって！
武士の風上にもおけねえ野郎だ！
story.english: A samurai siding with foreigners? You're a disgrace!
story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
story.rationale: Keep the contemptuous question and accusation in Kurushima's voice.

story.clean_Japanese:
大陸の沿岸を荒らし、無抵抗の民から
略奪するは
誇り高き武士の為すことか！
story.english: You raid the mainland coast and rob people who can't fight back. Is that how a proud samurai behaves?
story.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
story.rationale: The direct charges and rhetorical question answer Kurushima's appeal to samurai honor.

story.clean_Japanese:
おーおー、お堅えことを
俺の一番嫌いな性格だぜ
story.english: Oh, listen to you. So stiff and proper. Just the sort I can't stand.
story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
story.rationale: The mocking aside shifts from talking about honor to insulting Yukihisa personally.

story.clean_Japanese:
へっへっへ、FIよ！
俺の女になるなら、おとなしく降参
してもいいぞ！
おめえの命だけは助けてやろう！
story.english: Heh heh, FI! Agree to be mine and I'll let you surrender without a fight. Yours is the only life I'll spare!
story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
story.rationale: The offer is permission for Maria to surrender on his terms. Correct the English subject while retaining the threat, coercion, and native given-name substitution.

story.clean_Japanese:
ソウジン・クルシマ…
それ以上無駄口を叩くようなら、その
威気高な髭をむしり取ってあげるわ
story.english: Sojin Kurushima... Mouth off again and I'll pluck out that high-and-mighty beard!
story.speaker: Maria Li
story.rationale: The insulting threat ridicules his pretension and rejects his offer in Maria's voice.

story.clean_Japanese:
がっはっはっは！
……ぶち殺ーす！！
story.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
story.rationale: The bitter turn from laughter to an explicit threat closes the exchange.

shared.clean_Japanese:
提督、%sが
のっとられちまった！
shared.speaker: Sailor

shared.speaker: Sailor

shared.speaker: Sailor
shared.rationale: The short question leaves the player to confirm or revisit crew assignments.

shared.speaker: System

shared.speaker: Sailor

壊血病になったらしい！
shared.english: Admiral, it looks like the sailors have scurvy!
shared.speaker: Sailor
lines: Admiral, it looks like the sailors
shared.rationale: It looks like preserves the sailor's inference. It is an urgent report of a condition that appeared at sea.

shared.speaker: Sailor

shared.speaker: Sailor
shared.rationale: The shared alarm preserves the separate food substitution when that stock also runs out.

shared.clean_Japanese:
うう…目が回る…
腹が減った…
もう…ダメだ…
shared.english:
Ugh... My head's spinning...
  I'm so hungry... I can't go on...
shared.speaker: Sailor
lines: I'm so hungry... I can't go on...
shared.rationale: The three fragments progress from dizziness to hunger and finally to exhaustion.

shared.speaker: System
shared.rationale: The original warning substitutes the flagship's name. With no crew on the remaining vessel, the game ends the voyage.
